```{r}
all_data <- full_join(final_indispo,final_nuclear_indispo,
                      by = "indispo_day") %>% 
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct.Date(indispo_day))


all_data <- left_join(price_data,all_data,  by='datetime')

country_temp_instrument$datetime <- as.POSIXct(country_temp_instrument$Date)
info_selected$datetime <- as.POSIXct(info_selected$Date)
  
all_data <- left_join(all_data, country_temp_instrument,  by='datetime')
  
all_data <- left_join(all_data, info_selected,  by='datetime') %>% 
  mutate(month= month(datetime), year= year(datetime))
  

colnames(all_data)
```

Some regressions

```{r}
all_data_intradaily <- all_data %>%
  mutate(T_avg = na.locf(T_avg))

# perform first stage regression
m_basic <- lm(
  spot_price ~ TTF + wind + solar + nuclear_indispo + tot_indispo + gen_tot + T_avg,
  data= all_data_intradaily)

# dummy for creneau

m_timeFE <- lm(
  spot_price ~ TTF + wind + solar + nuclear_indispo + tot_indispo + gen_tot + T_avg + factor(year) + factor(month) ,
  data= all_data_intradaily)

m_log <- lm(
  log(spot_price) ~ log(TTF+1) + log(wind+1) + log(solar+1) + log(nuclear_indispo+1) + log(tot_indispo+1) +log(gen_tot+1) +  log(T_avg - min(all_data_intradaily$T_avg) +1) ,
  data= all_data_intradaily)

# dummy for creneau

m_log_timeFE <- lm(
  log(spot_price) ~ log(TTF+1) + log(wind+1) + log(solar+1) + log(nuclear_indispo+1) + log(tot_indispo+1)+ log(gen_tot+1) +  log(T_avg - min(all_data_intradaily$T_avg) +1)  + factor(year) + factor(month) ,
  data= all_data_intradaily)

```



```{r, results = 'asis'}
library(stargazer)

all_data_intradaily$year <- factor(all_data_intradaily$year)
all_data_intradaily$month <- factor(all_data_intradaily$month)
# Extract non-factor variables from the data
non_factor_vars <- names(all_data_intradaily)[sapply(all_data_intradaily, function(col) !is.factor(col))]

# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic,  m_timeFE, m_log,  m_log_timeFE,
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE", "Log", 'Log Time FE'),
    keep = non_factor_vars
 )

```

```{r}

all_data_daily <- all_data %>% 
  group_by(as.Date(datetime), month, year) %>% 
  dplyr::select(spot_price, TTF, wind, solar, nuclear_indispo, tot_indispo, gen_tot , T_avg) %>% 
  summarise_all(mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()
  
  
# perform first stage regression
m_basic <- lm(
  gen_tot ~ TTF + wind + solar + nuclear_indispo + tot_indispo + T_avg + spot_price ,
  data= all_data_daily)

# dummy for creneau

m_timeFE <- lm(
  gen_tot ~ TTF + wind + solar + nuclear_indispo + tot_indispo + T_avg + spot_price + factor(year) + factor(month) ,
  data= all_data_daily)

m_log <- lm(
  log(gen_tot) ~  log(TTF+1) + log(wind+1) + log(solar+1) + log(nuclear_indispo+1) + log(tot_indispo+1) + log(T_avg - min(all_data_daily$T_avg, na.rm = TRUE) +1)  + log(spot_price+1) ,
  data= all_data_daily)



m_log_timeFE <- lm(
  log(gen_tot) ~ log(TTF+1) + log(wind+1) + log(solar+1) + log(nuclear_indispo+1) + log(tot_indispo+1) + log(T_avg - min(all_data_daily$T_avg, na.rm = TRUE) +1)  + log(spot_price+1)+ factor(year) + factor(month) ,
  data= all_data_daily)



```



```{r, results = 'asis'}
library(stargazer)

all_data_daily$year <- factor(all_data_daily$year)
all_data_daily$month <- factor(all_data_daily$month)
# Extract non-factor variables from the data
non_factor_vars <- names(all_data_daily)[sapply(all_data_daily, function(col) !is.factor(col))]

# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic,  m_timeFE, m_log,  m_log_timeFE,
    type = "html",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE", "Log", 'Log Time FE'),
    keep = non_factor_vars
 )

```
